id: \bGoh: We wore it down. Finish it off.
en: \bGoh: We wore it down. Finish it off.
it: \bGoh: L'abbiamo indebolito. Dagli il colpo di grazia.

id: \bGoh: Where to start? This place is huge.
en: \bGoh: Where to start? This place is huge.
it: \bGoh: Da dove cominciare? Questo posto è enorme.

id: \rYou won't get the best of me.
en: \rYou won't get the best of me.
it: \rNon avrai la meglio su di me.

id: \bI'm not looking for anything either. Nope. Not at all.
en: \bI'm not looking for anything either. Nope. Not at all.
it: \bNeanch'io sto cercando niente. No. Proprio per niente.

id: \bGoh: I don't think Articuno is here.
en: \bGoh: I don't think Articuno is here.
it: \bGoh: Non credo che Articuno sia qui.

id: \bI'll find Articuno. Maybe we could team up.
en: \bI'll find Articuno. Maybe we could team up.

id: \bGary: You're here too, huh? I suppose we could use your help.
en: \bGary: You're here too, huh? I suppose we could use your help.
it: \bGary: Ci sei anche tu, eh? Direi che il tuo aiuto ci farebbe comodo.

id: \bI'll battle you with the Pokémon I just caught.
en: \bI'll battle you with the Pokémon I just caught.
it: \bLotterò contro di te con il Pokémon che ho appena catturato.

id: \bI should have spent more time training it.
en: \bI should have spent more time training it.

id: \bGary: That's more than enough data. Good job everyone.
en: \bGary: That's more than enough data. Good job everyone.
it: \bGary: Sono dati più che sufficienti. Ottimo lavoro, ragazzi.

id: \bGoh: Thanks. Sorry if I got in the way.
en: \bGoh: Thanks. Sorry if I got in the way.
it: \bGoh: Grazie. Scusate se sono stato d'intralcio.

id: \bGary: You'll learn. For now, it's time to go.
en: \bGary: You'll learn. For now, it's time to go.
it: \bGary: Imparerai. Per ora, è ora di andare.

id: \rAre you with Project Mew as well?
en: \rAre you with Project Mew as well?
it: \rFai parte anche tu del Progetto Mew?
\rHo intenzione di trovare Articuno per prima.

id: \bI'm too cold to move. Don't worry about me.
en: \bI'm too cold to move. Don't worry about me.
it: \bHo troppo freddo per muovermi. Non preoccuparti per me.

id: \bThere's a lot of people here today. I'm confused about it.
en: \bThere's a lot of people here today. I'm confused about it.
it: \bOggi qui c'è un sacco di gente. Non ci capisco niente.

id: \bI know you. You're in the Ultra Class.
en: \bI know you. You're in the Ultra Class.
